title: Stack and Heap

answers: One million bytes, the whole buffer
None at all — a move is just a reference
writing.exampleCaption: Three words on the stack; the bytes are on the heap.
writing.explanation: The stack is a bump pointer with a size known at compile time, freed automatically as frames pop. The heap holds anything sized at runtime or outliving its frame, and needs an owner to free it. Box, Vec, and String are heap values with a small stack handle, which is exactly why moving one is cheap and cloning one is not.
writing.feedback: A move copies the handle; the heap allocation never moves.
